notes: Facts the automatic zones cannot read from UW2's levels alone, in the format of uw1-facts.json (see its notes). Every docs/facts/uw2-*.json is read, this file first. The castle plot (X clock 1) is a count in the solver: a fact that grants plotset:V sets it to V, one that grants plotstep:NAME adds one, and plot:N in a requirement asks for the highest set plus the steps to reach N. The levels' own set variable traps are read automatically (the plot's 1, 2 and 3 on levels 3, 9 and 14, the steps of the gems picked up on levels 26 and 48); the steps below come from conversations and the schedules. Not here yet: the end of the plot (13 to 16: the djinn's bottle, the eight gems fused, Nystul's spell), and so no goal.

facts.notes: Let the Avatar die (running into walls at speed does it): outside Britannia he wakes by the blackrock gem on castle level 5, keeping all he holds and losing a ninth of his experience. With no health left on any level above 8 player_is_dead teleports him to level 5 and do_gem puts him a step from (28, 40), 2 to 4 health below full, mana an eighth and 2 below full, poison and running spells gone; nothing is taken from the pack, and what was held on the cursor is dropped where he died. No castle plot or facet is asked for, so it works from a world the gem still keeps shut. In Britannia (levels 1 to 8) death ends the game, except at the hands of a castle guard on level 1 (jail). Asleep in the Void after a dream plant he only wakes where he slept. Dying during a fight in the Pits' arena also clears the pit record and Jospur's debt (quest bytes 1 and 5). If no free square is found near the gem the game ends.
facts.source: Karl, 2026-11-16; game/SKILLS.C player_is_dead, do_gem, punt_mouse_obj; game/UWEDIT.C new_player_pos; ui/INTERACT.C (hp 0)

facts.notes: Gate Travel (Vas Rel Por, circle 6) cast on the moonstone of castle level 3, held in the pack, takes the Avatar to the other moonstone, which lies loose at level 45 (18, 48) in the Scintillus Academy, from any level. UW2 has two moonstones and remembers the level each lies on (3 and 45 at the start, 0 while carried). The spell is aimed at a moonstone (one in the pack or within reach); it goes to the level of the one that is not carried, and do_mstone lands on the square of the first moonstone found there, looking inside containers too. With both carried it fails. The moonstone of level 45 must stay where it lies. The other way, holding level 45's to go back to the chest on level 3, is not counted: it needs level 3's left in its chest, which this way takes. A moonstone put down elsewhere becomes the target (a movable return point, as in UW1); the logic does not follow that. The usual casting rules hold: not from runes on levels 1 to 8 (above circle 3), a new character casts it only once the start's free area is left. Asleep in the Void's dream no teleport leaves the Void.
facts.source: combat/SPELLS.C obj_spells case 15 (player->moonstones, Obj_FindInMap, do_mstone); game/SKILLS.C do_mstone, moveto; obj/OBJECTS.C Obj_FindInMap, Obj_InList (recurse into contents); ui/INTERACT.C mous_in_inv and the world click (ObjectActor on the object picked); inv/BAGS.C DoSpecialActions (a moonstone put down records the level); event/WORLDEV.C do_teleport (the dream's limit); level 45 moonstone #975

facts.notes: Karl: Merzan in Killorn Keep sells one potion of Iron Flesh when asked for it by name. The price is 2 x (50 - a Charm discount) gold: 100 with no Charm. He takes gold coins (item 160) by their number and treasures (items 161 to 170) at a third of their value; the logic counts the coins alone, a hundred of them (gold_100). He flees when the keep is about to fall (quest 50).
facts.source: conversation 105 (Merzan): babl_ask contains 'iron flesh', global34 = 2 * (50 - global37), func_16CB (item 160 count_inv, 161-170 identify_inv / 3), do_inv_create(226) with link 512 + 59, take_from_npc(226), once (global66); the_keeps_going_down (quest 50)

facts.notes: The force field before Bishop's cell at the top of the Prison Tower (level 16 (31, 33)) is lifted out of the way for one who wears fraznium gauntlets or the fraznium circlet. facts.notes: Karl: the Scintillus Academy's lava room (level 43) is crossed by jumping from pillar to pillar, with the pillars raised and lowered by the six buttons on the side walls, which the level's telekinesis wand presses from afar; nothing else is needed, and falling into the lava is failing the puzzle, not a way. The pillars are a 5 by 3 grid three squares apart from (27, 34), toggled between heights 2 and 10 (hack 20); the way runs from the ledge at (33, 31) over the middle column to the passage at (33, 43).
facts.source: Karl, 2026-11-14; event/WORLDEV.C toggle_pillars_hack; level 43 buttons #1018 to #1023, hack traps #999 to #1009

facts.notes: Karl: no solve may ever depend on the deaths of Killorn Keep's two brain creatures (whoami 0x3A, level 18 #241 at (29, 30) and #253 at (32, 28), not hostile): killing both makes the keep fall (quest 50, then quest 54). By rule nothing they carry counts (each holds two eyeballs, item 0x110), nor anything a fact grants on them, and no requirement may ask for flag:killorn_fallen, the token that would stand for the fall. They block no way the logic uses: their room (zone of level 18 (29, 24)) is walked through. See lost_killorn_17 for the walkthrough's warning.

facts.notes: Killorn Keep is held up by two brain creatures (whoami 0x3A, level 18 #241 and #253; a soldier: 'they hadda herd in a few extra brain creatures to hold up the extra weight'). The second one killed sets quest 50: the keep's people cry that it is going down, a countdown runs, and leaving level 17 or the countdown's end crashes it (quest 54). Then the schedule kills every creature of levels 17 and 18 and fires the triggers that make the ruins. A choice the player can always avoid: nothing in the logic needs the brain creatures dead.
